import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_3.csv"
source4_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_4.csv"

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv(source4_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation plan:
# The target table Target5_96 has a single column: Profit (float).
# Only Source2 contains the Profit column.
# Other sources provide dimension/context data with keys to join:
# - df0: Cust_id (customer dimension)
# - df1: Ship_id (shipping dimension)
# - df2: central fact table with Ord_id, Cust_id, Ship_id, Profit, etc.
# - df3: Ord_id (order dimension)
# - df4: Prod_id (product dimension)
#
# To ensure all source tables are used, join them all on their shared keys:
# Join order:
# df2 (fact) is the core table with Profit.
# Join df0 on Cust_id
# Join df1 on Ship_id
# Join df3 on Ord_id = Ord_id (note df2 has Ord_id as 'Ord_id', df3 has 'Ord_id')
# Join df4 on Prod_id
#
# After joining, select only the Profit column as target schema requires.
# No aggregation or group by needed since target examples show Profit values directly.
# The join keys are consistent and primary/foreign keys.
#
# Note: df2 columns:
#   Ord_id, Prod_id, Ship_id, Cust_id, Sales, Discount, Order_Quantity, Profit, Shipping_Cost, Product_Base_Margin
# df3 columns:
#   Order_ID, Order_Date, Order_Priority, Ord_id
# df1 columns:
#   Order_ID, Ship_Mode, Ship_Date, Ship_id
# df0 columns:
#   Customer_Name, Province, Region, Customer_Segment, Cust_id
# df4 columns:
#   Product_Category, Product_Sub_Category, Prod_id

# Perform joins step-by-step:

# Join df2 with df0 on Cust_id
df_20 = pd.merge(df2, df0, on="Cust_id", how="inner")

# Join df_20 with df1 on Ship_id
df_201 = pd.merge(df_20, df1, on="Ship_id", how="inner")

# Join df_201 with df3 on Ord_id
df_2013 = pd.merge(df_201, df3, on="Ord_id", how="inner")

# Join df_2013 with df4 on Prod_id
df_all = pd.merge(df_2013, df4, on="Prod_id", how="inner")

# Extract the Profit column as float type
result = df_all[["Profit"]].copy()
result["Profit"] = result["Profit"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/target_multisource_cot.csv"
result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_96_2 with Source5_96_1 on Ship_id
df = pd.merge(source2, source1, how='inner', left_on='Ship_id', right_on='Ship_id')

# Join with Source5_96_3 on Ord_id (note: source2 has 'Ord_id', source3 has 'Ord_id')
df = pd.merge(df, source3, how='inner', left_on='Ord_id', right_on='Ord_id')

# Join with Source5_96_0 on Cust_id
df = pd.merge(df, source0, how='inner', left_on='Cust_id', right_on='Cust_id')

# Join with Source5_96_4 on Prod_id
df = pd.merge(df, source4, how='inner', left_on='Prod_id', right_on='Prod_id')

# Aggregate sum of Profit (no group by since target has only one column Profit)
result = pd.DataFrame()
result['Profit'] = [df['Profit'].sum()]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_96/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
